meta.description: Fixed-root MCP adapter for inspecting, generating, optimizing, previewing, forking, and applying changes to a pinned local Site Planner workspace.
meta.author: RUDI
meta.boundary: The adapter executes only the configured Site Planner JSON CLI against a fixed workspace and exact clean Git revision. It does not perform zoning, entitlement, parking, finance, or underwriting analysis.
meta.secretGuidance: Keep SITE_PLANNER_WRITE_HMAC_V1 in RUDI secret state. Do not expose it to agents, logs, artifacts, configuration JSON, or tool output.
